text:
ali_ops: quick flag 026-04-02: humidity alarm tripped in transit for H200 crate batch PO#60777. Seeing intermittent boot errors on 9 sampled units. Quarantining at CD-LHR.

sandra_procure: how many total and which serial ranges? any customer impact yet?

ali_ops: batch size 120. sampled serials H200-60777-0001..0120, failures concentrated in 00015,00027,00041,00062,00073,00088,00099,00102,00115 (9 total). Non-deterministic failures after 10-25m burn.

marco_logistics: LHR crossdock holding. Broker notes humidity spike to 76% on 2026-04-01 23:40 UTC. Filing HS amendment to classify as repair/return to avoid import duty.

nexa_supply_ops: vendor preliminary: likely minor ingress; propose depot rework kits + per-serial depot preflight. Offer: 2.5% credit or expedited air replacement for up to 6 units in 5 days with 1.5% credit.

olga_sales: prioritize SLAs. If we can secure 6 air units in 5 days, route those to top S1 customers. Otherwise route US spares to cover.

rma-bot: Draft RMA RMA-2026-6222 created (unit_count=9, requested_preflight=true).

sandra_procure: commercial ask: vendor covers return freight for failed units, provides depot preflight bench logs per serial (bench_id, therm_profile, kv_check), and 4% credit if we accept depot repair. Otherwise we want 6 expedited replacements and 3% credit.

nexa_supply_ops: vendor counter: 3% credit + return freight covered for failed units if we accept depot repairs. Expedite 6 in 5 days at 2% credit if we sign limited holdback. They will provide bench logs for depot-repaired units only.

ali_ops: technical constraint: any repaired unit must pass a 45m thermal burn and KV cache retention test before release. Add metadata `preflight_spec=45m_burn+kv_retention` to RMA. Also require `bench_id` attached.

marco_logistics: HS amendment AM-60777 filed. ETA 20-28h. Crossdock can quarantine but cannot create export labels until broker confirms repair classification.

olga_sales: customer comms: short message ready: "We've quarantined a small subset of recent H200s due to transit humidity. We're prioritizing replacements for critical customers and performing additional QA. We'll provide daily updates."

sandra_procure: trade-off call: accept 3% + vendor-covered freight + preflight logs for repaired units, and insist on contract clause: vendor must replace any depot-repaired unit that fails our preflight within 3 days at vendor expense. If they won't sign, escalate to head of procurement.

nexa_supply_ops: vendor tentatively agrees to the 3-day re-replace clause and will supply preflight logs for depot repairs. They'll send updated commercial terms within 6 hours.

ali_ops: ops checklist: 1) run stress-test on 24 random units, 2) tag failing serials `rma-humidity`, 3) prepare RMA labels draft, 4) ready US spare transfer if vendor terms insufficient. I'll run tests now.

rma-bot: Reminder: attach original invoices to RMA for credit reconciliation.

marco_logistics: provisional crossdock order CD-LHR-60777 created; awaiting HS clearance.

sandra_procure: thanks all. I'll review vendor amendment when it comes and loop legal if salvage language appears.

ali_ops: will post first stress-test logs in ~40m. :mag:
